description: Client-only, needs enableUiControl. List the widgets of the open screen in focus order: id, type (button, checkbox, cycle, slider, text_field, text, other), text, active, checked (checkboxes), value (text fields) and position in GUI coordinates. Works on the pause, title, death, options, advancements, statistics and confirmation screens, container screens and screens added by other mods; the world, server, chat, link, command block and other sensitive screens are refused (ui_refused). Custom-drawn parts such as inventory slots are not widgets: use the container tools for those.
name: get_ui
title: List the widgets of the open screen
